catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds a simulated quadrotor attitude/thrust command. cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 and cap.motion.cartesian_twist.v1 bind robot.arm and carry Cartesian positions or twists, not the Crazyflie roll/pitch/yaw-rate/thrust message.
catalogue_requests.summary: Publish a Crazyflie roll/pitch/yaw-rate/thrust setpoint on the upstream command topic.

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class observes a simulated UAV odometry sample. The package exposes the position, orientation and twist of nav_msgs/Odometry; the world.sim classes advance or reset a world and do not read a vehicle odometry topic.
catalogue_requests.summary: Read one ideal odometry sample from the simulated Crazyflie.

The last gate output (python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/gsilano__crazys --backend fake --verbose, exit 1) was: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour: error G6.ESTOP_FAILED: mhs.safety.estop: status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED: the device reports that its safe state was not reached; the latch stays engaged; retrying in the background (estop 'engaged', expected engaged or software_only); G7 pass Native surface; G8 warn Protocol and surface: warning G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE: the suite awards CL2: SAFE-014 (out-of-limit refusals) has nothing to probe because the driver declares no limit on any actuating capability; every other CL3 test passed; G9 skip Repository tests: warning G9.NOT_RUN. FAIL: G6. The report digest is sha256:206be917f666c9c4921586e6015a9d715cd94d53923604cc48ee0ceda6a0446f.

WHY HELPER_MISSING (stop path). The package's primary control is the Crazyflie direct flight command publication on /crazyflie2/command/roll_pitch_yawrate_thrust (mav_msgs/RollPitchYawrateThrustCrazyflie). The relative upstream token "command/roll_pitch_yawrate_thrust" is at rotors_control/include/rotors_control/common.h:40-42; the subscriber is at rotors_control/src/nodes/roll_pitch_yawrate_thrust_crazyflie_node.cpp:35-38; the type include is at rotors_control/src/nodes/roll_pitch_yawrate_thrust_crazyflie_node.h:25. The clone has no acknowledged stop service or action for the vehicle. The only ros::service::call in the clone is /gazebo/unpause_physics with std_srvs/Empty (rotors_gazebo/src/nodes/hovering_example.cpp:41-42), which starts physics, not stops it. The advertised services are the bag recording service (rotors_gazebo_plugins/src/gazebo_bag_plugin.cpp:111-113) and world/get_octomap (rotors_gazebo_plugins/src/gazebo_octomap_plugin.cpp:50-52); neither stops the vehicle. Joy::StopMav zeroes roll, pitch, yaw_rate and thrust in a local joystick message (rotors_joy_interface/src/joy_crazyflie.cpp:61-66), but it is not a ROS service or action. RosDriver safety bindings accept only fixed service or action calls, and a zero-velocity or zero-thrust publication is explicitly not an acknowledged stop. The bridge therefore reports safe_state achieved=false and the stock e-stop fails with MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED. I did not fabricate a [...]

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the command and odometry endpoints and types (relative command/roll_pitch_yawrate_thrust at rotors_control/include/rotors_control/common.h:40-42 under the crazyflie2 group of crazyflie2_with_joy.launch:3,29; odometry_sensor1/odometry at mav_generic_odometry_sensor.gazebo:35; the nested nav_msgs/Odometry paths), all facts and the stop: the clone has no service or action that stops the vehicle, so the author's HELPER_MISSING block is confirmed. Fixed: a fact and the docstring called /gazebo/unpause_physics the only ROS service call in the clone, but the rqt_rotors HIL plugin creates MAVROS arming, command and set_mode clients and arms an autopilot (rqt_rotors/src/rqt_rotors/hil_plugin.py:45-47, 90-92, 104-105), now stated; the four actuating inputs had no Limit at all, now Limit.operator_required with a new site-limits.example.json; two facts carried 'so ...' or 'does not reject' inferences, narrowed, and two service facts described callbacks outside their ranges, now split onto the callback lines (gazebo_bag_plugin.cpp:411-431, gazebo_octomap_plugin.cpp:57-74), as was the controller fact that relied on line 227, where SetRollPitchYawrateThrust sets controller_active_ for good; and the launch's competing joystick publisher, its fixed paused=true (odometry silent: the resource read fails NOT_READY at 2 s and each command completes only after it, reviewer probe) and the HIL path are now in new facts and gaps. Reviewer changed driver.py, fake.py (ROS 1 Odometry shape with header seq, child_frame_id and covariances), test_driver.py (a LIMITS_UNSET case and an overlay case), facts.md, added site-limits.example.json, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate now fails only G6.ESTOP_FAILED (G8 passes and its SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE warning is gone); the eight package cases pass. RESULT.json notes saying 'No Limit is declared' and that the only ros::service::call is /gazebo/unpause_physics are superseded. For the human reviewer: No acknowledged stop: a zero roll/pitch/yaw-rate/thrust publication is fire-and-forget, Joy::StopMav only zeroes a local message, and the joystick interface republishes on every joy message. The rqt_rotors HIL plugin arms a real MAVROS autopilot and sets HIL mode; it is outside this package. The command type mav_msgs/RollPitchYawrateThrustCrazyflie is defined outside the clone; its roll, pitch, yaw_rate and thrust fields are evidenced only by the clone's use (joy_crazyflie.cpp:33-36, 72-91). Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop (for example a checked Gazebo pause or a controller stop service) or an SDK profile for it.
